title: `BaseButton`: multitouch support
orig_rationale: Base BaseButton multitouch feature (touch_index/device_id, screen touch/drag handling); absent from the fork and the prerequisite for the multitouch fix chain (PRs 119329/118653/118608/118542). Defer as the feature port that unblocks the rest.

title: Add option to scale images in RichTextLabel relative to font size
orig_rationale: Adds a RichTextLabel option to scale images relative to font size, with a new API, doc changes, and a compat.inc shim. New feature; defer as a dedicated feature port.

title: Implement search bar for `PopupMenu`
orig_rationale: Implements the visible PopupMenu search bar (11 files incl. OptionButton, editor themes, new icon); a sizable feature the fork lacks - defer to a dedicated port. Prereq for 117958.

title: GUI: Add accessibility region role for landmark navigation
orig_rationale: Adds accessibility ROLE_REGION plus Container.accessibility_region for landmark navigation (13 files, incl. diverged editor docks/main-screen/bottom-panel). Uses the DisplayServer accessibility API present in the fork, but is a feature touching diverged editor areas - defer.

title: Add translation context to Controls
orig_rationale: Adds a per-Control translation_context property plus a Node _get_translation_context_with_override virtual wired into the translation pipeline and scene translation parser; new localization infra not present in the fork. Defer as a feature port.

title: Improve the table in `RichTextLabel`
orig_rationale: Large RichTextLabel table reflow rework (~310 lines; renames _set_table_size to _update_table_column_width/_update_table_size). Big behavioral refactor, defer to a dedicated effort; it is the prerequisite for 116701.

title: Add `custom_maximum_size` property to `Control`
orig_rationale: Adds the Control custom_maximum_size / propagate_maximum_size feature across ~47 files; entirely absent from the fork and the root dependency for the whole max-size fix cluster (118651/118536/118591/118351/118323/120280/120346). Defer as the feature port.

title: Improve `get_tab_control()` in TabContainer
orig_rationale: Refactor of TabContainer get_tab_control (adds _as_tab_control helper); a non-bugfix refactor of an area the fork's multi-scene workspace leans on. Defer, low urgency.

title: Remove redundant calculation code in `RichTextLabel::_get_line_max_width()`
orig_rationale: Removes the RTL column_max_width_dirty lazy path on the premise columns are precomputed in _shape_line() - that precompute comes from the 116277 table refactor, which the fork lacks. Blocked on 116277.

title: Move accessibility methods/enums from `DisplayServer` to the `AccessibilityServer` dedicated singleton.
orig_rationale: Moves all accessibility methods/enums from DisplayServer into a new AccessibilityServer singleton (88 files, new servers/drivers). Large cross-cutting infra refactor; the fork still uses DisplayServer accessibility. Gates every AccessibilityServer-based PR - schedule as its own effort.

title: Add triple-click paragraph selection to RichTextLabel
orig_rationale: Triple-click paragraph selection in RichTextLabel; converts the selection double_click bool to a SelectionMode enum (~100 lines) - a selection-semantics feature, defer. Note 117201 builds on its enum/last_double_click members.

title: Do not show accessibility configuration warnings for non-focusable controls, account for name fallback.
orig_rationale: Only warn about accessibility name on focusable controls plus name-fallback helper; valuable, but written against the post-refactor AccessibilityServer API (116839) across 21 files while the fork still uses DisplayServer accessibility. Needs 116839 first or non-mechanical adaptation.

title: [Accessibility] Add CodeEdit code completion support.
orig_rationale: Adds CodeEdit code-completion accessibility (173 new lines); written against the post-refactor AccessibilityServer/AccessibilityServerEnums API absent in the fork. Blocked on 116839.

title: Add `_get_tooltip_auto_translate_mode_at()` to Control
orig_rationale: Adds virtual _get_tooltip_auto_translate_mode_at() override point across Control/ItemList/Tree/Viewport (9 files); a feature extension, defer to a dedicated effort rather than a bugfix port.

title: Handle Tree's root and foreign item drops better
orig_rationale: Improves Tree root and foreign-item drop handling via _determine_hovered_item and the reworked drag-section/_find_item_at_pos code, which the fork's older Tree does not have. Defer with the Tree drag-section rework.

title: Implement fuzzy search for `PopupMenu` search bar
orig_rationale: Fuzzy search for the PopupMenu search bar; edits _filter_items/_search_bar_text_changed which come from the search-bar feature (114236) absent in the fork, and pulls in core/string/fuzzy_search. Blocked on 114236.

title: Increase max RID count for some owners, decrease RID usage by `RichTextLabel`.
orig_rationale: Restructures RichTextLabel Item RID ownership (Item frees its own rid; drops the owner ObjectID) and raises RID owner capacity in the text servers and accesskit driver. Broad, cross-file, ABI-adjacent; the fork matches the parent Item model but this warrants a deliberate port. Defer.

title: Fix tab bar max width behavior
orig_rationale: Fixes TabBar minimum-width behavior using combined_max/stop_adding/computed_max_width, which are part of the absent max-size feature. Blocker: PR 116640.

title: Reorganize `Control` inspector layout
orig_rationale: Reorders Control inspector Layout-group properties including custom_maximum_size and propagate_maximum_size, which the fork does not bind (max-size feature absent). Blocker: PR 116640.

title: Defer minimum size updates in maximum size handling
orig_rationale: Defers the minimum-size update inside update_maximum_size (call_deferred instead of direct); update_maximum_size does not exist in the fork. Blocker: PR 116640.

title: Fix BaseButton popup unresponsive on touchscreen after first tap
orig_rationale: Resets touch_index after a button-press action so later taps aren't dropped, and refines the device_id gate; depends on the multitouch feature (touch_index/device_id) absent from the fork. Blocker: multitouch base feature.

title: Fix `MeshLibrary` crash
orig_rationale: Despite the title, the diff edits Control::update_maximum_size to sync deferred minimum-size propagation via updating_last_minimum_size; update_maximum_size and the max-size machinery do not exist in the fork. Blocker: PR 116640.

title: Fix BaseButton multitouch signals firing for only 1 button
orig_rationale: Adds an is_touch_press_inside branch in BaseButton::on_action_event so multitouch presses inside the button fire; only meaningful with the multitouch feature (screen_touch handling) absent from the fork. Blocker: multitouch base feature.

title: Deprecate `TabContainer.all_tabs_in_front` due to now being useless
orig_rationale: Deprecates TabContainer.all_tabs_in_front (turns the setter into a warning) behind DISABLE_DEPRECATED, on the premise tabs are 'always in front' due to unrelated internal changes. Adds a compat shim and removes working behavior; the clean-break fork should decide deliberately. Pairs with PR 119420.

title: Fix `TabBar` and `Label` being unable to shrink when given a maximum size
orig_rationale: Makes TabBar/Label (and many containers) able to shrink under a maximum size; built entirely on the custom_maximum_size/get_combined_maximum_size feature absent from the fork (33 files). Blocker: PR 116640.

title: Fix: support multi-input for `BaseButton` with Alt + Click
orig_rationale: Removes the device_id gate in BaseButton::gui_input to allow Alt+Click multi-input; only meaningful on top of the multitouch feature (touch_index/device_id) which is absent from the fork. Blocker: multitouch base feature (PR 110893).

title: Fix custom canvas item covers text
orig_rationale: Adds a separate custom_ci canvas item so custom-drawn content doesn't cover text; custom_ci does not exist in the fork's Tree (4.7 canvas-item rework). Blocker: Tree custom_ci rework.

title: Fix positioning of `PopupMenu` submenus
orig_rationale: Reworks _activate_submenu positioning to add scroll_container_offset; the fork's _activate_submenu has diverged variable naming and this is the first of a submenu-positioning chain that culminates in the search-bar-dependent PR 119439. Defer with that chain.

title: Fix `PopupMenu` gamepad navigation when filtered
orig_rationale: Adds items[i].visible checks to PopupMenu gamepad navigation; item visibility (filtering) is part of the absent search/filter feature. Blocker: item-visibility/filter infra.

title: Fix `PopupMenu` using the wrong separation when searching/filtering
orig_rationale: Fixes separation for the first *visible* item when items are hidden by filtering; relies on item visibility from the absent search/filter feature. Blocker: filter infra.

title: Fix `PopupMenu` input handling when scaled/padded
orig_rationale: Moves get_tooltip onto a PopupMenuItems control and scales mouse coordinates by content_scale_factor, relying on the search-bar-era popup structure (PopupMenuItems, search_bar, vbox_container) that the fork lacks. Blocker: diverged/search-era PopupMenu.

title: Fix various issues with `PopupMenu` fuzzy search
orig_rationale: Fixes PopupMenu/OptionButton fuzzy search behavior; depends on the absent search-bar/fuzzy-filter feature. Blocker: search-bar feature.

title: Fix various accessibility issues in `PopupMenu`
orig_rationale: Fixes PopupMenu accessibility around the search bar (_search_bar_focus_entered, _filter_items, vbox_container); all reference the absent search-bar feature. Blocker: PopupMenu search-bar feature.

title: Fix `Input.parse_input_event` `Button` regression
orig_rationale: Reworks BaseButton::gui_input touch/device_id handling introduced by the multitouch feature (PR 110893), which is absent from the fork (no touch_index/device_id in base_button). Blocker: multitouch base feature.

title: Fix incorrect `get_drop_section_at_position` results in Tree
orig_rationale: First hunk edits the 4.7-reworked _find_item_at_pos (parent_allows_drop/current_item_depth/hide_root) which does not exist in the fork's older Tree drag-section code; only the get_drop_section '!drop_mode_flags' guard is cleanly portable. Defer with the Tree drag-section rework.

title: Split `PopupMenu.search_bar_enabled_on_item_count` into two properties
orig_rationale: Splits PopupMenu.search_bar_enabled_on_item_count into two properties; the entire search-bar feature is absent from the fork. Blocker: search-bar feature.

title: Fix and improve selection behavior in the Filesystem dock
orig_rationale: Large filesystem-dock selection rework (320-line dock refactor) that also edits Tree drag-section code and adds a tree.compat.inc shim; touches the diverged Tree drop-section area and introduces a compat shim the clean-break fork avoids. Defer as a dedicated effort.

title: [RTL] Update line start items after delete.
orig_rationale: Changes the meaning of line.from (root line no longer points to main; constructor sets from=nullptr) and updates remove_paragraph accordingly; this is part of the diverged RTL line-from redesign and would interact with the fork's heavy l.from usage. Defer with the RTL shaping rework.

title: Fix incorrect tooltips in `PopupMenu` when the search bar is enabled
orig_rationale: Fixes incorrect PopupMenu tooltips when the search bar is enabled; depends on the absent search-bar feature. Blocker: search-bar feature.

title: Always disable `all_tabs_in_front` in `TabContainer`
orig_rationale: Finalizes deprecation of TabContainer.all_tabs_in_front (getter returns false, property becomes USAGE_NONE) behind DISABLE_DEPRECATED. Depends on the 'tabs always in front' internal change and adds a compat shim; the clean-break fork should decide deliberately. Pairs with PR 118623.

title: Fix `PopupMenu` submenu positioning not accounting for margins
orig_rationale: Reworks _activate_submenu vertical positioning and references submenu_popup->search_bar and theme_cache.search_bar_separation, which are part of the absent PopupMenu search-bar feature. Blocker: search-bar feature + diverged submenu positioning chain.

title: Fix PopupMenu counting separators for search bar
orig_rationale: Adjusts separator counting for the PopupMenu search bar; the fork has no PopupMenu search bar (search_bar absent). Blocker: PopupMenu search-bar feature.

title: [RTL] Fix last line height with some fallback fonts.
orig_rationale: Introduces it_prev tracking plus a trailing zero-width space after the shaping loop in _shape_line; the fork's _shape_line has diverged (no it_prev, its own 0x200B handling using it->rid). Needs deliberate reconciliation of the RTL last-line-height logic.

title: [RTL] Fix indent / list level not taken into account.
orig_rationale: Reworks RTL indent/list nesting to use ItemIndent::level/ItemList::level and removes ItemFrame::indent_level, changing push_list/push_indent semantics across append_text. This is a design change to a diverged RTL area, not a self-contained fix.

title: [RTL] Do not add zero-width space to last line without content.
orig_rationale: Changes 'it_prev = l.from ? l.from : current' to 'it_prev = l.from' in _shape_line; depends on the it_prev/zero-width-space rework from PR 119987 (70ee45d), and the fork's _shape_line has diverged (no it_prev variable). Port 119987-era RTL shaping first.

title: Fix `BoxContainer` size when theme scale is not an integer
orig_rationale: Adds .ceil() to get_bound_desired_size()/get_bound_minimum_size() in BoxContainer::_get_minimum_size(p_use_desired_sizes); those symbols and that signature are part of the 4.7 custom_maximum_size feature absent from the fork. Blocker: max-size infra (PR 116640).

title: Partly revert updated warning in `Label`
orig_rationale: Refines Label autowrap warning to also check get_custom_minimum_size, but the condition uses get_combined_maximum_size() which does not exist in the fork (part of the max-size feature). Blocker: PR 116640.
